title: Sprint 1 — HTML/CSS Portfolio
description: Build a stunning developer portfolio from scratch using HTML and CSS. You will learn semantic markup, layout design, and modern CSS techniques.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Page Structure & Navigation
tickets.description: Set up the core structure of your portfolio. You will create the semantic foundation, a sticky header with a logo, navigation links, and a footer.

tasks.title: Task 1 — Semantic Page Skeleton
tasks.description: Create the main structural layout for your webpage, establishing key sections like header, main content areas, and footer.

tasks.title: Task 2 — Sticky Navigation Bar
tasks.description: Build a sticky header with a logo and navigation links using flexbox and CSS positioning.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Hero Section
tickets.description: Design a captivating full-screen hero section. You'll add a vibrant gradient background, an introductory badge, and call-to-action buttons.

tasks.title: Task 1 — Hero Layout
tasks.description: Structure the hero section using flexbox to center content vertically and horizontally.

tasks.title: Task 2 — Typography & Buttons
tasks.description: Style the hero typography and create eye-catching primary and secondary call-to-action buttons.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — About & Projects Grid
tickets.description: Build out your "About" section with statistics cards, and construct a responsive 3-column grid for your portfolio projects.

tasks.title: Task 1 — About Section & Stats
tasks.description: Use CSS Grid to lay out your about text and statistics cards.

tasks.title: Task 2 — Projects Grid
tasks.description: Create a 3-column responsive grid to showcase your project cards.

tickets.title: Ticket 4 — Skills + Contact Form
tickets.description: Implement a tag-cloud layout for your skills and design a clean, accessible HTML contact form.

tasks.title: Task 1 — Skills Tag Cloud
tasks.description: Use flex-wrap and pill-shaped tags to display your technical skills.

tasks.title: Task 2 — Contact Form
tasks.description: Build a semantic contact form with labels, inputs, textareas, and proper focus states.

tickets.title: Ticket 5 — Polish & Animations
tickets.description: Take your portfolio to the next level with CSS animations, smooth transitions, glassmorphism, and a refined footer.

tasks.title: Task 1 — CSS Animations
tasks.description: Add @keyframes animations to your hero section and hover transitions to all interactive elements.

tasks.title: Task 2 — Final Polish
tasks.description: Implement a multi-column footer and apply glassmorphism effects to your sticky header.
